name: JARVIS-CI-Local
description: Local n8n replacement for paid GitHub Actions. Calls the JARVIS CI bridge (scripts/ci_bridge_server.py, a localhost wrapper around scripts/ci_bridge.py) which lists open PRs, gates each head SHA in a local shadow worktree via scripts/ci_gate.py, and can publish commit statuses. n8n v2 removed the Execute Command node, so local commands run through the bridge over HTTP instead. Edit the Config node to choose how many PRs to gate and whether statuses are published.

nodes.name: Schedule every 6h
nodes.notes: Automatic poll. Activate the workflow to enable this trigger.

nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Click the editor's Run button to gate on demand.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit limit / dryRun / pr in this node's code.

nodes.name: Run Local CI (bridge)
nodes.notes: POSTs to the localhost CI bridge, which runs scripts/ci_bridge.py. Bound to 127.0.0.1 and token-authenticated.
